steps.text: Ocular organizes visible head movements for instructor review.
Image input uses the actual local head model.
Boxes and labels describe head direction. Counts are observations, not identities.
Unknowns stay explicit. Head movement alone cannot establish misconduct.
This is a permitted two-second office-meeting proxy with four fixed positions.
Four seats are configured manually. Direction labels remain camera-relative.
Processing is real CPU inference. The interface offers Stop and does not invent progress percentages.
Completed review contains synchronized source video, seat states, histories and records.
Selecting a movement record seeks to its source-video time.
Per-seat histories preserve observed intervals and explicit gaps.
120 processed frames; 1 descriptive movement records. Event accuracy is unvalidated.
Reload reopens saved results without rerunning inference.
Validated here on the demo laptop. This proxy does not establish classroom event correctness.

limitations: Browser automation, not independent human usability acceptance.
Public-domain office-meeting proxy, not classroom event ground truth.
Silent recording uses explanatory on-screen captions.
